text: The Snake repo has no build tool; a pom.xml (Maven, Java 11, sourceDirectory=src) was added in PR#1 as the project foundation
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md added in PR#2 is the canonical modernization plan for the Snake project — BA reads this to create issues
Snake modernization uses FlatLaf (Apache 2.0) for modern Swing theming and javax.swing.Timer to replace Thread.sleep game loop
Critical Snake bug: stopTheGame() at ThreadsController.java:73 loops forever on collision — game must be force-killed to restart
Snake v2 architecture prioritizes visual enhancement (FlatLaf + custom GamePanel rendering) over backend refactoring — no package rename or GameState extraction
Replacing 400 JPanel cells with a single GamePanel.paintComponent(Graphics2D) is the key enabler for all visual improvements in the Snake modernization
